note: A rule is keyed on its rightmost compound, cut only at a combinator outside brackets, parentheses and quotes, and on the classes that compound puts on the element itself. li:not(.acme-btn) styles no .acme-btn, so the <Button> carrying it reports no system/override (line 1); a combinator inside :not() is not a cut, so line 2 keys to the live .acme-row, not .acme-ghost. :nth-child(2n+1), a quoted attribute with a space and :is(.a .b) keep their compound whole, so .acme-orphan, .acme-gone and .acme-stale are dead (lines 4-6) while .acme-item is live (line 3).
